newsitem.title: USA: BlueCross-Missouri has no comment on merger report.
newsitem.headline: BlueCross-Missouri has no comment on merger report.

text.p: Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Missouri on Friday declined comment on a published report that it might merge with a St. Louis-based hospital group.
The insurer said its publicly traded RightChoice Managed Care Inc subsidiary has about 1.8 million members in Missouri.

"At any point in time, specific business combinations may be under review and consideration by our boards," Roy Heimburger, president and chief executive officer of Blue Cross-Missouri, said in a statement. "We have an established policy not to comment on any specific opportunities or to confirm or deny rumors in the market."

Heimburger, who is also chairman and chief executive officer of RightChoice, added, "It is our stated objective to maximize shareholder and member value through acquisitions, mergers, joint ventures and other business opportunities."
The St. Louis Post-Dispatch newspaper reported today that BJC Health System might be negotiating to buy Blue Cross-Missouri.
A BJC spokeswoman declined comment on the report. She said BJC is a non-profit group of hospitals. The Post-Dispatch said it has 13 hospitals and six nursing homes.
